Super Moist Chocolate Cake
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 11:21pm

Ingredients




5 cups of all purpose flour (can substitute w
3 tablespoons of sifted good quality cocoa
1 teaspoon baking soda
1 cup white or vegan brown sugar
5 teaspoons salt (optional)
5 tablespoons canola oil (can substitute with any veg. 
1 tablespoon white vinegar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 cup cold water





Preparation

1 By far the most surprisingly deeelightful cake. This recipe is great for adults and for kids ages 3 and up. 2 1. Put your flour into mixing bowl, add cocoa, baking soda, vegan sugar and salt and mix well. 3 2. Make three deep holes in the dry mixture. Into one, pour the oil, into the next, pour the vinegar into the next, pour the vanilla. 4 3. Pour the water into the bowl, over all of this--- making a great big mess. 5 4. Mix the wet and dry ingredients together until there aren't any more lumps and pour into a 9 inch by 9 inch baking pan, two inches deep, it doesn't even have to be greased. 6 5. Bake at 350 for about half an hour, test with a fork. 7 Enjoy this delicious cake. You will be surprised at its moistness and richness!!!!! It can be cooled and iced with your choice of icing or can be enjoyed on its own. The batter can also be used to make cupcakes!! 8 TIP OF THE DAY: for an instant cake, have the premeasured, premixed dry ingredients at hand, then simply add the wet ingredients when you want a fresh treat! It makes a great birthday cake! Hey, it even freezes well! 9 Preparation time: 15 min. + 30 min. bake. 10 Submitted by: kph
